facts.fact: GabonReview reports an ordinance on digitalisation, published in the Journal officiel on 7 September 2025, makes digital sovereignty a priority through control and securing of public data.
Minister Doumba says companies have been created online at ANPI for 4 or 5 years, with close to 50,000 companies created, and that CNSS and CNAMGS declarations are expected to follow online.
